meta.cite: Barton O. Oliver's mTOR Atlas. doi:10.5281/zenodo.22059963

data.mechanism: PIP3 pulls Akt to the membrane, where it gets phosphorylated and activated.
data.mechanism_beginner: That lipid pulls Akt to the cell membrane, where it gets switched on.
data.context: PIP3 recruits Akt; recruitment alone does not activate it. Full activation additionally needs PDK1 (T308) and mTORC2 (S473), so the strength of this link depends on the activity of both of those.
data.boundary: Mammalian cell study (LIU2015) plus a review (CAN2002). Cell biochemistry; not tested in whole animals or in people by the cited sources.
